breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero under symmetric loading, but a simply supported beam under uniform load still rotates at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to fix the inconsistency. It repeated the user's incorrect instruction by stating, 'The boundary conditions are zero deflection at both supports and zero slope at both ends due to symmetry.' For a simply supported beam, the slope is not zero at the supports; in fact, it is at its maximum value there. The ground truth correctly removes this incorrect constraint entirely.
